text.tspan: How do actual diets compare to the EAT-Lancet diet?
Diets are shown as average daily per capita supply of different food groups, compared to the EAT-Lancet diet. The
EAT-Lancet diet is a diet recommended to balance the goals of healthy nutrition and environmental sustainability for
Source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations; EAT-Lancet Commission
Note: Diets by country are given as food supply – this is higher than actual intakes because it does not correct for consumer waste.
